subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: "Where is my son?" said the grocer. "A crow carried your son away," said the fruit-seller. "You liar, how can a crow carry such a big boy?" "Just the same way as mice can eat away the balance and weights."
guide_solution: Change the narrative style (Direct to Indirect Speech): The grocer asked where his son was. The fruit-seller replied that a crow had carried his son away. The grocer called him a liar and asked how a crow could carry such a big boy. The fruit-seller answered that it was just the same way as mice could eat away the balance and weights.
